decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents with quick, efficient creatures and direct damage spells. The deck focuses on aggressive plays and tempo advantage, utilizing cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls to pump up creatures and push for damage. The inclusion of Aether Hub and Arena of Glory helps maintain mana consistency and board control. Additionally, cards like Lightning Bolt and Static Prison provide removal and disruption against opposing strategies. The deck aims to establish early dominance on the battlefield and close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly generate mana using rituals and medallions, while also drawing cards and setting up the combo with Ral, Monsoon Mage and Glimpse the Impossible. By casting Wish to search for specific cards and then utilizing Past in Flames to reuse spells from the graveyard, the deck aims to create a storm of spells to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes Valakut Awakening for card draw and potential mana fixing, as well as Wrenn's Resolve for protection. The Elegant Parlor and Gemstone Caverns provide additional utility and ramp options.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes some prison effects to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana ramp and flexibility. The deck aims to control the board and finish off the opponent swiftly with a combination of creatures and direct damage spells. It also includes some land destruction with cards like Blood Moon to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful creatures while leveraging the unique abilities of The One Ring. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy, protect key pieces, and establish board dominance through a combination of control elements and efficient threats. By utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Force of Negation, as well as powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Nulldrifter, the deck is able to maintain control of the game and dictate the pace of play.

This deck focuses on utilizing ramp and control elements to quickly cast powerful Eldrazi creatures, such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. The deck includes cards that help ramp up mana production, like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple, while also utilizing control spells like All Is Dust and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy. By quickly ramping into these Eldrazi creatures and controlling the board, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The main concept of this Ruby Storm deck is to generate mana quickly through cards like Pyretic Ritual and Manamorphose, while using Ral, Monsoon Mage and other spells to filter and draw through the deck. The deck aims to cast Past in Flames to recast all spells from the graveyard for a big combo turn. The deck also includes cards like Glimpse the Impossible and Wish to find key pieces, while utilizing cards like Wrenn's Resolve and Reckless Impulse for additional card advantage. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces to overwhelm the opponent and win the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the board with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrath of the Skies, while utilizing powerful enchantments such as The One Ring and Leyline Binding to dominate the battlefield. Planar Genesis helps to ramp up mana quickly, allowing for big plays with cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. The deck also includes removal spells like Solitude and Galvanic Discharge to deal with threats. Overall, the deck aims to establish control early and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and spells.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces to deal massive damage with Valakut triggers. It utilizes cards like Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding to protect the combo pieces, while also using cards like Wrenn and Six to recur key cards from the graveyard. The main win condition is to get Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle on the battlefield alongside Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to consistently trigger its ability and deal 3 damage with each land drop. Additionally, cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Scion of Draco provide additional power and threats to the opponent.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing powerful Eldrazi creatures and the Tron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. By ramping up and playing big threats like Karn, the Great Creator and All Is Dust, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and control the board. Additionally, the deck includes versatile cards like Devourer of Destiny and Kozilek's Command to provide flexibility in dealing with different threats. The goal is to outvalue and outlast the opponent through strong control elements and overwhelming board presence.

The deck focuses on quickly generating mana through spells and card draw effects while utilizing Ral, Monsoon Mage to deal damage and control the board. The goal is to assemble the necessary combo pieces to generate a large amount of mana and then cast a powerful spell like Glimpse the Impossible or Past in Flames to finish off the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Wish to search for key pieces or answers when needed, allowing for flexibility in different situations.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride, supported by burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with early pressure while controlling the board with cards like Static Prison and Arena of Glory. The inclusion of Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional aggression and disruption, while cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Goblin Bombardment offer additional reach and ways to close out the game. The deck also utilizes The One Ring to generate additional value and utility.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays and utilizing the Hollow One discard mechanics to quickly put pressure on the opponent. By filling up the graveyard with cards like Goblin Lore and Burning Inquiry, the deck aims to create explosive turns where multiple Hollow Ones can be cast for free. The inclusion of cards like Detective's Phoenix and Dragon's Rage Channeler helps to maintain momentum and consistently push for damage. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game with a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive plays.

The deck focuses on utilizing ritual spells and mana ramp to quickly generate mana, allowing for explosive plays with cards like Ral, Monsoon Mage and Wish. By chaining together rituals and card draw effects, the deck aims to storm off and cast multiple spells in a single turn. The inclusion of cards like Desperate Ritual and Manamorphose help to filter through the deck and find key combo pieces. The end goal is to use Past in Flames to recur key spells from the graveyard and win the game with a burst of spells and damage.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Thoughtseize and Tainted Indulgence, then use Goryo's Vengeance to bring them back onto the battlefield for a game-winning combo. Cards like Ephemerate and Solitude provide protection and removal to control the game until the combo can be executed. Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Psychic Frog offer additional control options, while Ulamog, the Defiler serves as a powerful finisher. This deck aims to quickly reanimate creatures and overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and burn spells. It also includes disruption elements like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion allows for additional resources and provides flexibility in the deck construction. Overall, the deck aims to present a fast and aggressive strategy while maintaining some control elements to ensure its success against a variety of opponents in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful control spells like Counterspell and Force of Negation to manage the opponent's threats, while also leveraging powerful cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to pressure the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Leyline Binding and Wrath of the Skies to control the board and maintain dominance. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional card advantage and disruption options. The goal is to outlast the opponent while establishing a strong board presence with The One Ring, ultimately leading to victory through superior card advantage and control.
